name: Sorcerer
notes: Discovers magic through spellbooks and experiment (CONSTITUTION §4): Ember and Mage Hand at the start, every later spell from a book, a forbidden teacher or a deed (ADR-0004). The fire chain past Ember is the sorcerer's own. Grey-box kit: staff, robe and two mana draughts.
pitch: A reader of forbidden books. Every spell is learned, and fire is only the first.
